J&K Health Minister’s Assurance Leads NHM Employees to Postpone Strike

National Health Mission (NHM) employees in Jammu and Kashmir had planned a strike. The state health minister issued a written assurance to the workers. Following the assurance, the employees decided to defer the strike. The written assurance states that all the workers' demands will be satisfied within a month. The development was reported by Greater Kashmir and Dainik Jagran. No further action or timeline beyond the month was mentioned.
